about: The communio of the formulary “Sunday after the Ascension” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Father, while I was with them, I kept those whom You gave Me, alleluia. But now I come to You. I do not pray that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from evil, alleluia, alleluia.

w030.note: After the preposition “a,” the noun “malum,” evil, and “malus” used as a noun, the Evil One, share the ablative form “malo.” A neuter noun analysis represents “evil.” The form alone neither excludes the personal sense nor settles the interpretation of this Gospel passage.
